notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2025 August Update
notes.notes:
Endless Campaign Game
I am slightly disappointed that this announcement wasn't announcing a release date but to be honest I am behind my schedule of where I would have liked to be.  I continue to toil away at this feature and it is a larger effort than I had initially scoped.  Currently this feature is over 85% done and now its down to bug fixes, extra details and testing.  Once released this extra play mode will be included as part of the base game, every current and future released DLC will enhance it but none will be required to play it. 


DLC Pandemonium Portals Update
Pandemonium Portals is over 95% completed.  I could likely release this in a few weeks but I am going to stick with the original plan and have Pandemonium Portals release at the same time as the Endless Campaign update.  As mentioned before you will not need Pandemonium Portals to play the Endless Campaign but it will have some features that support and enhance the Endless Campaign as well as being a full stand alone DLC like the other DLCs that have been released.  



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804780/Mythical_Mayhem__Pandemonium_Portals/"][/dynamiclink]


Future of Mythical Mayhem
After the Endless Campaign and Pandemonium Portals is released their will likely be a break and also we might have 1 or 2 minor updates if required, to fix any game issues.  As always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. I don't want to set hard time lines but this could finish out 2025.  After this I am thinking of creating a small free to play Demo and then doing a pirate/sea faring themed DLC expansion.  I also still have ideas for a few more DLCs so we will see where things end up.  As always I plan to continue to monitor and remain actively engaged with all Fans of Mythical Mayhem (on the steam boards and Mythical Mayhem Discord).   



Thanks to all the fans that have supported Mythical Mayhem and your continued support and patience.

notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2025 May Update
notes.notes:
Endless Campaign Game
I am currently working away planning one of the most requested features for Mythical Mayhem the Endless Campaign.  This is going to be released as part of the main game at no additional charge.  Quite a few things will be similar to the main campaign but there will be differences.  It will not have campaign balance and it will not have an overarching story focus, the story focus will be quite light.  There will still be Side Stories, Market, Campaign Commerce, Choices for Quest rewards.  I will be introducing a new campaign resources and deck manipulation will play a bigger role. Hopefully the Endless Campaign will be able to be released towards the end of summer.  It's initial state that it releases will be built in a way that is fully playable but with most things could possible be improved upon in later updates.


DLC Pandemonium Portals Update
Pandemonium Portals is the 3rd planned DLC for Mythical Mayhem.  The plan is Pandemonium Portals will release the at the same time as the Endless Campaign update; you will not need Pandemonium Portals to play the Endless Campaign but it will have some features that will play into that update as well as some standard items that work similar to the other DLCs like new campaign quests, new heroes, new arch villains,  new foe sets and new minions along with other new items.  Price will likely be similar to Twisting Sands.


Future of Mythical Mayhem
After the Endless Campaign and Pandemonium Portals is released their will likely be a minor break and also we might have 1 or 2 minor updates if required, to fix any game issues.  As always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. Looking further ahead towards the end of 2025 I will look to do a smaller DLC possible the pirates themed one.  After that into 2026 I still have ideas for a few more DLCs so we will see where things end up.  Also Mythical Mayhem has 3 items I would love to see: 1 different video resolution support.  2 Support for localization.   3. Multi-Player.  I have investigated these items in depth and despite me wanting all of these features the reality is Mythical Mayhem will most likely never have any of them.  I don't like to deal in absolutes but the reality is any these features would have needed to be designed from the start; who knows maybe someday I might develop a Mythical Mayhem 2    but that is still just an idea for the future.  As always I plan to continue to monitor and remain actively engaged with all Fans of Mythical Mayhem (on the steam boards and Mythical Mayhem Discord).


Thanks to all the fans that have supported Mythical Mayhem along its journey.  I am looking forward to continuing our journey together.

notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2025 May Update
notes.notes:
Endless Campaign Game
I am currently working away planning one of the most requested features for Mythical Mayhem the Endless Campaign.  This is going to be released as part of the main game at no additional charge.  Quite a few things will be similar to the main campaign but there will be differences.  It will not have campaign balance and it will not have an overarching story focus, the story focus will be quite light.  There will still be Side Stories, Market, Campaign Commerce, Choices for Quest rewards.  I will be introducing a new campaign resources and deck manipulation will play a bigger role. Hopefully the Endless Campaign will be able to be released towards the end of summer.  It's initial state that it releases will be built in a way that is fully playable but with most things could possible be improved upon in later updates.


DLC Pandemonium Portals Update
Pandemonium Portals is the 3rd planned DLC for Mythical Mayhem.  The plan is Pandemonium Portals will release the at the same time as the Endless Campaign update; you will not need Pandemonium Portals to play the Endless Campaign but it will have some features that will play into that update as well as some standard items that work similar to the other DLCs like new campaign quests, new heroes, new arch villains,  new foe sets and new minions along with other new items.  Price will likely be similar to Twisting Sands.


Future of Mythical Mayhem
After the Endless Campaign and Pandemonium Portals is released their will likely be a minor break and also we might have 1 or 2 minor updates if required, to fix any game issues.  As always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. Looking further ahead towards the end of 2025 I will look to do a smaller DLC possible the pirates themed one.  After that into 2026 I still have ideas for a few more DLCs so we will see where things end up.
